title: 4-Digit Division Word Problems
intro: Teach students to interpret a remainder in the context of the story.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Label the total and group size before dividing. Have the student describe the complete groups and what is left, then choose a suitable activity range.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Total: 1,237 counters. Group size: 6 counters.

1,237 ÷ 6 = 206 R 1
206 × 6 + 1 = 1,237

Quotient: 206 full groups. Remainder: 1 counter.

Ask your student

What does the remainder represent here?

If your student needs help

If the student ignores the remainder, ask where the leftover objects belong in the model.
